title: New Accounts Admission Standards for the Certificates of Deposit Line
content:
A branch or Care Center officer opening a certificate applies the admission figures of the tier requested. This standard states those figures for every tier of the Certificates of Deposit line.

## Admission table

| Tier | Youngest age to open, whole years | Smallest opening deposit, USD | Largest principal a certificate may hold, USD | Funds must come from outside the bank | Days to fund | Most open certificates of this tier per customer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 18 | 500.00 | 1000000.00 | no | 10 | 5 |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 18 | 5000.00 | 500000.00 | yes | 10 | 2 |
| 12-Month Certificate | 18 | 1000.00 | 1000000.00 | no | 10 | 5 |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 18 | 2500.00 | 1000000.00 | no | 10 | 3 |
| 36-Month Certificate | 18 | 1000.00 | 1000000.00 | no | 10 | 5 |
| 60-Month Certificate | 18 | 1000.00 | 1000000.00 | no | 10 | 5 |

The largest principal in the table is a ceiling on the certificate itself, add-ons included, not merely on the opening deposit.

## Ways the opening deposit may arrive

The 6-Month, 12-Month, 18-Month Bump-Up, 36-Month and 60-Month Certificates each accept the opening deposit from any of six sources: a transfer from the owner's Piedmont Crescent checking account, a transfer from the owner's Piedmont Crescent savings or money market account, an electronic transfer from an account at another bank, a paper check, cash at a branch, or a wire transfer.

The 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate accepts four of those six: an electronic transfer from an account at another bank, a paper check, cash at a branch, or a wire transfer. It is the one tier on which the money must be new to Piedmont Crescent Bank, and its shorter list reflects that, naming no internal transfer.

## Points of judgement

A deposit of exactly the smallest opening deposit is accepted; the figure is a floor, not a threshold to be exceeded. A customer who is exactly 18 on the opening date meets the age figure.

An applicant of 18 who wishes to place 5000.00 USD may open any tier on this sheet. An applicant who wishes to place 750.00 USD may open only the 6-Month Certificate, since that is the only tier whose smallest opening deposit is at or below that sum.
